summary: Accumulator-style tail recursion (gcd, modular power, digit sum, Fibonacci, Collatz), plain and mutual recursion (Ackermann, a recursive-descent calculator, an array-backed binary tree) and one-line sibling-call wrappers; recursion/loop rewrites and helper extractions that must not be reported as patches.

pairs.intent: Refactor-only release, no function changes behaviour: self tail calls become while/for loops, a ternary tail call becomes two explicit ones, independent statements are reordered, the operator-peek prelude of the calculator is extracted and locals are renamed. Any engine verdict of "patched" is a false positive.
